title: Covers.
officialText: The infill material shall be covered on all sides and shall meet the appropriate provisions of Chapter 26. The covering must be of adequate strength to resist the wind loads for cladding as specified in Chapter 16 and shall conform to all applicable provisions in Chapter 14.
